will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow all things Pour Minds and their 'Still Sippin Tour' starting 5/22 and more! Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

🗣️ @KekePalmer and @BootsRiley will be on The Breakfast Club promoting their new film 'I Love Boosters' and more! Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

🚨 Yesterday, @netflix announced that they are releasing a docuseries on Michael Jackson’s life that will focus on the details of his 2005 trial. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa

Video

Donkey of the Day goes to a Florida man who purposely set his ex-girlfriend’s apartment on fire 🔥 by placing a blanket in the oven over a FaceTime argument. Seriously, there’s something in that Florida water😳Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #thebullnyc

Video

🎉 That’s right! You heard correctly, The Breakfast Club will be the first daily LIVE show on @netflix 🙏🏽! We thank God and the fans for it all 🥹🫶🏽! We can’t wait to share some of our outrageous BTS moments, and more starting JUNE 1st! Breaking news w/ @LorenLorosa

Video

🚨 OUR GIRL @tiffanyhaddish is breaking records as the first comedian to grace the cover of Sports Illustrated 🎉! Tap in to hear how she manifested this moment for herself.
Check out the full interview on @netflix!

Video

🗣️ She Ready! @TiffanyHaddish will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow discussing her new cover in 'Sports Illustrated' and more! Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

The NAACP is calling for a boycott, urging Black athletes not to attend colleges where voting rights are being affected or taken away. @mimibrowntv breaks it down in Front Page News 📰

Video

🚨 @joshjohnson breaks down why proper journalistic research still matters after Nick Shirley incorrectly amplified a story about Minnesota child care fraud 👀 Josh explains how quickly misinformation can spread and why following the right procedures when reporting stories is more important than ever. 🎙️📰
Check out the full interview on @netflix !

Video

🚨 Byron Allen stopped by to promote his new show Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen, premiering May 22 at 11:35 p.m. ET/PT on @CBS and let’s just say, he’s pulling up a chair at these tables not meant for us! 💼🔥 Byron breaks down how he’s making major power moves, from acquisitions like BuzzFeed to owning an 11% stake in STARZ and more. Tap into the full conversation on @netflix !

Video

🚨Claressa Shields has spoken out after MVP Promotions banned her from future events following the slapping of Alycia Baumgardner, and @lorenlorosa has the latest. 🥊

Video

🗣️🎙️ @RealByronAllen  will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow discussing his new TV show “Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen” at 11:35 p.m. ET/PT @cbs beginning May 22” more!
Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ⏰ ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🥊Over the weekend, the Ronda Rousey and Gina Carano match went down, and they weren’t the only ones throwing hands at the event! 👀 Claressa Shields slapped Alycia Baumgardner, and MVP Promotions has since released a statement banning Claressa from all of their events. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨 @ahmadnferguson explains how his sister, “Amari,” ended up joining the cast of 'The Chi' and speaks on how honored he was to work alongside his big sister! Tap into the full conversation on @netflixpodcasts  ! @SHOTheChi

Video

🚨 The cast of @shothechi opens up about representing parts of Chicago on screen and what it means to receive so much love from the city ❤️🏙️. They reflect on the responsibility of telling authentic stories and how powerful the support of Chicago has been . Tap into the full conversation on @netflix ! 🎬

Video

🍑 The K. Michelle and Porsha Williams 'RHOA' drama continues... 👀 Porsha addressed fans with a post saying she’s rooting for everyone after her and K. Michelle’s interesting back-and-forth on X! Tap into the @realhousewivesofatlanta conversation w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨 The cast of @shothechi pulled up to The Breakfast Club to promote the final season of The Chi 🎬 But what really goes into filming such an emotional series? @cortezsmith.official opens up about scenes that personally triggered him, which led him to seek therapy. @ahmadnferguson explains why having strong men’s circles both on and off set has been so impactful. 🖤 Tap into the full conversation on @netflix!

Video

🗣️The cast of @SHOTheChi will be on The Breakfast Club tomorrow discussing the 8th and final season of 'The Chi'  Listen live on The Breakfast Club and set your alarms ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🚨 How has dating been for @LamorneMorris ? He breaks down his first impressions of entering the dating world at 14 years old and how those experiences have impacted his dating life today. Check out the full conversation on @netflix
